title: Java4Shell: Critical OpenJDK Flaw Allows Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
content_md: A heap overflow vulnerability in the OpenJDK Base64 decoder, tracked as CVE-2026-114938, lets remote attackers run code on Java servers with AVX-512 processors. Patches are available. Article Link: https://www.security.com/threat-intelligence/java4shell-cve2026114938-patch-now
